name: artifact-codegen
description: Generates tailored Python build scripts (DOCX, PPTX, HTML, XLSX) from upstream marketing/outreach registries. The caller executes the emitted scripts to produce final binaries. Reconciles FlowFabric's no-Python-in-flow rule with the reality that binary deliverables require code: the flow emits the code, the caller runs it, and Claude amends on failure.
